title: Arkret Agent Sidecar
description: Controller-owned private AI workspace bound one-to-one to (realm_id, controller_id). Agent Sidecar is a first-class protocol object, not a Circle profile or editable membership container. Its backing_circle_id is reducer-derived and system-managed solely as the private delivery/MLS scope. See spec/v1/zh/models/sidecar.md.

backing_circle_id.description: Reducer-derived system-managed private delivery/MLS scope. Raw ensure callers MUST NOT supply or mutate this field; the service-built canonical ak.sidecar.create payload MUST materialize it. Ordinary Circle APIs MUST NOT expose or manage the referenced Circle.

encryption_profile.description: Agent Sidecar is always protected by an independent MLS group; plaintext fallback is invalid.
